plugins.description: Ask Genaya AI about your own business from Claude: today's schedule, who owes you, revenue, calls, clients and your team, answered from your Genaya records as you. Ask for a change (a task, a client, a reschedule) and Genaya prepares it, shows a preview and runs nothing until you confirm.
